executionBlockers: payment UI driver and compiled application fixture unqualified

independent transaction, funding ancestry and spendability oracle required

journeys.title: Send to an identity key, receive, accept and spend
steps: Start two independent funded fixture identities; verify receiving host advertisement and inbox
Enter recipient identity and integer amount; confirm through ordinary sender UI
Receive with live listener and explicit refresh; accept through receiver UI
Restart both applications and spend the received output
oracles: Correct BRC-29 output, derivation metadata, exact amount and recipient
Durable delivery, receiver read-back and one internalization precede inbox acknowledgment
Controlled chain accepts a receiver spend; debits, credits, change and fees conserve value
Both UIs distinguish sent, delivered, pending and received; same-wallet cells still use separate identities

journeys.title: Recipient offline and returning-user inbox recovery
steps: Send while receiver listener is offline
Restart receiver; open Receive and explicitly refresh
Accept once and restart again
oracles: Stored payment survives absence of live listener
Received once with unchanged outpoint and metadata
No acknowledged message disappears before durable internalization

journeys.title: Discovery and host anointment failures
steps: Pin the actual discovery protocol and host advertisement used by each artifact
Inject the nominated routing failure and attempt a payment
Repair discovery through supported UI; retry the original pending payment
oracles: No unsupported discovery result is treated as validated recipient reachability
No false delivery success or silently discarded payment
If already created, signed bytes and remittance metadata remain durably recoverable
Unsupported host repair or resend remains BLOCKED; no automatic sender reclaim is inferred

journeys.title: Transport fallback, ambiguous acknowledgment and duplicate delivery
steps: Inject transport failure before or after durable server storage
Retry or fall back to the declared transport; restart both sides
Deliver the original message twice and accept through ordinary UI
oracles: Fallback and retries reuse one payment transaction and derivation metadata
One recipient credit and no repeated sender funding debit
No sent or delivered success without its declared evidence; pending outbox remains recoverable
Server durable storage and wallet internalization are distinct observations

journeys.title: Portable payment bytes in both directions
steps: Freeze exact transaction and dependency bytes at the supported wallet boundary
Send and receive through the real application and declared bridge
Compare recovered subject and dependency closure; spend received output
oracles: Byte values, output index, sender and derivation metadata survive transport
Legacy BEEF conversion preserves subject and necessary ancestry
Malformed or sparse representations fail before internalization and keep a recoverable row

journeys.title: Decline, cancellation, rejection and partial bulk acceptance
steps: Seed declared pending payments and required failure responses
Approve or deny the named UI action; execute mixed bulk acceptance
Reload and inspect every failed, accepted and rejected row
oracles: Permission denial differs from timeout or infrastructure failure
Failed acceptance keeps the payment and recovery metadata
Refund never draws unrelated wallet funds after failed acceptance
Tiny rejection policy and refund fees are disclosed; acknowledgment alone is not a refund

journeys.title: Open identity-key requests safely
steps: Open each supported entry path in its native OS and wallet
Inspect identity, amount and confirmation; cancel then deliberately confirm a fresh request
oracles: BRC-125 parsing, integer handling and explicit confirmation match the frozen standard
No broadcast before confirmation
Transport retries deduplicate one payment intent; separately confirmed payments remain independent
Camera, URI handler and clipboard claims require their actual native interfaces

journeys.title: New and returning receive views
steps: Connect through ordinary wallet permissions; create or restore saved addresses
Select a saved eligible address, refresh and reconnect
Compare wallet actions and payments before and after free selection
oracles: Saved selection creates no paid action; reconnect default follows declared policy
All retained addresses and known payments recover without application browser data
Unchecked or failed discovery is not displayed as a verified zero balance

journeys.title: Deposit, detect, import and spend
steps: Deposit controlled funds to the intended saved address
Refresh and verify exact known output; select Move to wallet
Observe unsigned preparation, withheld signing, one explicit submission and receiver spend
oracles: Exact deposit ownership, amount, input spend state and canonical proof verified
Import uses the requested deposit without optional stale migration inputs
Both UIs and wallet state agree on credit, fees and spent deposit
Reload never resurrects an imported output as spendable

journeys.title: Expired address and device-independent recovery
steps: Preserve wallet state while clearing only application state or restoring on another clean device
Restore known pre-sunset coins and eligible addresses
Attempt receiving on an expired address and inject one discovery failure
oracles: Expired new receiving stays blocked while retained historical funds remain accessible
No backend, browser cache or original-device dependency replaces wallet recovery
Known-output recovery preserves proof and metadata; partial failure retains restored rows

journeys.title: Spent inputs, interrupted signing and unknown submission
steps: Inject the named input, process or chain-evidence fault
Attempt import or send; restart application and wallet
Recover the original action before any replacement payment
oracles: Unknown input or header state blocks the action and never becomes zero funds
Two input checks, unchanged signed template and noSend signing protect one explicit submission
Uncertain submission blocks another spend until exact outcome reconciliation
Interrupted action, wallet metadata and original funds remain inspectable
